profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: With over 15 years of experience in Quality Assurance (QA), including more than half of that time dedicated to automation, I have cultivated a deep expertise in optimizing processes and ensuring the highest standards of product quality. My journey at Expeditors has been defined by a relentless pursuit of excellence, leveraging automation tools and methodologies to streamline testing workflows and drive efficiency. From developing robust test frameworks to implementing cutting-edge automation solutions, I have played a pivotal role in elevating the quality assurance practices at Expeditors. With a keen eye for detail and a passion for innovation, I continue to spearhead initiatives that not only meet but exceed expectations, delivering tangible value to the organization and its stakeholders.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description: Plan, execute, and maintain test cases.  Develop automation tools using Selenium and C#.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description: Create and execute manual test cases. Analyze functional specifications along side product management and software developers. Manage virtual machines for the engineering department.

positions.title: Software QA Intern
positions.description:
Interned for a few months at Onyx.  In my time there my main duties were to manage the virtual machines for each development team.  Each day a different team would get a new build to work on.  It was my job to take down the old environment and setup the latest build.  

I also assisted the QA team with executing test cases.
